description_zh: 此西壁下层的盞形龛仅为龛之一部分，另一部分折入南壁。龛内8身供养天分前后两排，头梳大髻并饰圆光，面相丰圆、眉目清秀。上身斜披络腋，下着长裙，帔帛穿臂后下垂。人物双手捧物供养，或胡跪、或长跪。
name_en: The third floor on the south side of the west wall in the back room.
description_en: It is only one part of the lower west wall, and the other part falls into the south. The eight parts of the wall provide for two rows of the sky, combing their heads and decorating them with roundness and browsing. The upper part is swollen, with long skirts and long arms on its back. A person has his hands on his feet, or kneels, or kneels long.

name_zh: 后室南壁窟门
description_zh: 南壁下层正中开圆拱形窟门，两侧各雕一立姿执金刚神，其上雕金翅鸟立于莲座之上。圆拱龛龛楣雕坐佛，上、下端饰夜叉与飞天。上端的夜叉中间置一博山炉；下端的飞天中间饰有一摩尼宝珠。拱楣上方左右两隅点缀供养天。该拱门设计巧妙，龛楣装饰富丽。
name_en: The south wall door in the back room.
description_en: In the lower part of the south wall, a circle of caves is opened, and each side is carved in a single position, with the golden winged bird standing above the Lotus seat. The bows are engraved with the Buddha, top and bottom, with the night fork and the flying sky. The upper end of the night fork has a mountain furnace; the lower end of the sky is equipped with a monetized bead. On the upper side of the ridge, there is a two-point feeder. The arch is well designed and decorated.

name_zh: 后室南壁明窗西侧
description_zh: 西壁北端的供养菩萨脚下有力士托扛。菩萨头戴三面冠，面相丰圆、曲眉细目，鼻残，嘴角上翘，饰圆形头光。颈戴桃尖形项圈，上身斜披络腋，下身穿羊肠大裙，佩臂钏、手镯，帔帛沿肩垂下穿肘外扬，双手相握于胸前，呈礼敬之姿态。下端力士体魄健壮，胸部肌肉隆起，双手高擎菩萨两足。明窗西壁北端力士托供养菩萨与东壁对应，设计内容大略相同。供养菩萨头戴三面高宝冠，面相丰圆、直鼻长眉、两眼微睁、脸含笑意，面部表情丰富。下端托扛力士，双手上擎，双腿似盘似蹲。
name_en: In the back room, south wall, west of the window.
description_en: With three-faced crowns on the north side of the west wall, full-faced, frown-and-brow lines, broken noses, horns on the mouth, adorned round headlights. The necks wear peach-shaped collars, caps on the upper side of their caps, skirts on the lower side of their lamb's intestines, arms and bracelets on their shoulders, stretching out of their elbows, holding hands in front of their chests, and posing with respect and respect. The lower end is strong, the lower end muscles rise, and their arms are two feet high. The north side of the west side of the window provides the same content as the east side, and the north side of the wall designs the same.

name_zh: 前室北壁窟门与明窗
description_zh: 前室北壁中央上开明窗、下辟窟门并与后室相通。方形窟门门楣与立柱皆雕刻得十分精美。门楣上置5枚高浮雕莲花形门簪，背景为浅浮雕复合动物忍冬纹，继承了汉代云龙纹的传统手法。门楣横额的上方、下方、左端与右门框皆略微倾斜，上方的门框内浅浮雕一宽一窄的环形忍冬纹、联珠纹饰带。而门楣左右两端及下方的短斜框内，浮雕忍冬纹或童子天人。两侧方柱内、外侧及外框斜面内亦刻复合动物忍冬纹。整个窟门及周围营造出一种罕见的建筑图案，特色鲜明，给人以庄重华丽之感。
name_en: In front, the north wall door and the window.
description_en: There are five high-floating boulders, with a background of shallow sculpturing complexes, bearing winter threads, which have inherited the traditional Han Dae-yun tattoos. The top, bottom, left and right door frames are slightly tilted, and a narrow ring-and-winter strip, as well as bead strips, are made from the top and bottom of the front wall. The doors are on both ends and below, and within the short edges of the door, they are engraved with winter-scene or child-like edges. There is also a complex of animals in both sides of the column, on the outside and on the outside.

name_zh: 前室北壁西侧第 4 层龛内主佛之间上部夜叉
description_zh: 龛内顶部二佛背光间雕二夜叉，头梳逆发、长眉细目、嘴角含笑，头饰圆光、身健体硕。上身斜披络腋，下身穿短裙，帔帛搭肘后凌空飞舞，姿态优美、对称均衡。
name_en: Top of the night fork between the Buddhas on the 4th floor on the west side of the north wall of the front room.
description_en: The two-night fork is carved from the top of the back, with hair combing backwards, eyebrows, a smile in the mouth, a round head and a strong body. The upper forelock is swollen, the lower fork is in short skirts, the elbow is elbowed and flying, and the posture is beautiful and symmetrical.

name_zh: 前室北壁西侧第 4 层龛右下隅弟子
description_zh: 弟子体格健硕，头略倾若有所思，面相丰圆、长眉细目、五官俊秀、长耳垂肩，着通肩式田相衣。右手举于胸前，左手置于体侧，双脚呈外八字形侧身立于平台之上。左肩及胸部残留晚期重修补塑施绘的痕迹。

description_en: My brother is a very strong man, with a slightly more thoughtful head, a full-faced face, a long eyebrow line, a five-man Joon-soo, a long-eared shoulder and a shoulder-placing field coat. His right hand is on his chest, his left hand is on his side, and his feet are on his side of the platform. The left shoulder and chest are left with traces of late restoration of the sculpting.

name_zh: 前室北壁西侧第 4 层龛左下隅弟子
description_zh: 弟子体格健硕、面相丰圆、细眉直鼻、小嘴微张、两耳下垂，内穿僧祇支，外披半袒右肩式田相衣。左手抚于胸前，右手提净瓶置于体侧，腹部微挺，双脚呈外八字形立于平台之上。身体和面部经晚期施彩。

The right hand is on the side of the chest, the vial is on the side of the body, the stomach is small, and the feet are in the outer eight-word form of the platform. The body and the face are painted at a late stage.

name_zh: 前室北壁东侧第4层龛龛楣上缘右侧飞天
description_zh: 此为龛楣上缘右侧的飞天，剃发童颜、弯眉圆目、直鼻小嘴，长耳佩圆形耳环，上身斜披络腋，下身着短裙，左臂与手残缺，右手举于胸前，帔帛绕肘外扬。

description_zh: 行过敷泥彩绘，但面相、身躯、手姿等不失北魏风格，宝盖更是仅在原环形忍冬纹和三角垂饰纹上施彩。人物面部轮廓保留北魏风格，五官已经变形和残损。佛像内着僧祇支，外穿半袒右肩式袈裟，衣纹流畅、线条清晰可见。

The shape of the face retains the North Wei style, and the five officers are deformed and mutilated. description_zh: 宝盖下雕立佛，面相丰圆，双肩宽厚，内着僧祇支，外着半袒右肩式袈裟。佛像双臂残损，身后饰莲花纹与忍冬纹头光和火焰纹身光，立于莲花座之上。佛的右脚之处雕一童子，外侧为供养菩萨。宝盖之上饰环形忍冬纹和三角垂饰带。图像雕刻内容或为罗睺罗因缘，或为燃灯佛授记本生。

They have lily and winter tattoos on their backs, and they have beams and flame tattoos on their sides. They have beams on their sides. They have three towers on their left and left, and they have beams on each side. They have beams on each side. They have beams on each side. They have beams on each side. description_zh: 此东梢间梁枋上的二飞天，头梳大髻、面相俊秀，上身斜披络腋，下身穿大裙。饰圆形头光，帔帛飞扬。上面的飞天右手上举握莲蕾状物，左手执于胸前；其下者右手上举、一手叉腰。两飞天回首相望、彼此呼应。

They are round-headed, and they fly. The upper right hand holds the lote, and their left hand is on their chests; and their right hand is raised, and their right hand is on their backs. The statues of the statues are special, and the tops are sculpted with three foliage strips, which are engraved in a row of petals, the bottom of which are triangulated, and are covered by redecorts. The flame of the Buddha's back is also red. A child kneels to the left side, faces to a female figure. The woman is big, heads are light, and she sits on a scaffolding seat, holding her hair long. The woman has two other high-stamped chaperial figures on the top, heads full. The four above are made of Buddhas. A child kneels on the right side, heads on the right side, heads on the right side, heads on the right side, heads on the right side, heads on the right side, and hands on the right side.

The cave caps are almost completely damaged, with only a few original works in the south, and the rest are later drawings.

name_zh: 西壁南侧第3层第3排右侧圆拱龛
description_zh: 龛内雕一佛、二胁侍菩萨。佛像着半袒右肩式袈裟，边饰折带纹。胁侍菩萨合掌立于龛内两侧。二飞天双脚踏于壁面上呼之欲出。龛楣雕7尊禅定坐佛，拱尾饰龙首返顾。龛基中央雕博山炉，左侧雕二男性供养人，右侧雕二僧侣及二女性供养人。

They have large bellows, tilted beams, and long skirts. The square beams, beams, beams, and seven pairs of sculpts, each on both sides, are set to feed the sky. The crouching scuffle has a smaller image, which contrasts strongly with the Bosano furnace. On both sides, it provides for the combing of the sky, wide shoulders, hands and legs, and kneels.

description_zh: 菩萨面容慈祥，左手提净瓶置膝头，右手上举为施无畏印，脚踏莲台坐须弥座。下身大裙纹饰密集。台座两端雕供养比丘。

name_zh: 窟门西壁
description_zh: 未按计划完工的窟门雕刻，北侧有涂色，壁面中间开槽是后世安装木门所致。壁面大致分4层，层间无明显间隔，残存9处形式、大小不同的龛像，均具云冈晚期造像风格。南侧壁面在1949年后曾予以修补加固。

The walls are roughly four floors, with no apparent distance between them, and nine images of different sizes and sizes are left in late-stage image style. The south side of the wall was repaired and reinforced after 1949.

name_zh: 南壁中部第 2 层龛龛额
description_zh: 有3个主题内容。一是位于龛楣外两上隅的伎乐天雕刻，伎乐天着通肩衣，手执乐器呈演奏状。二是千佛龛，共雕24座小型圆拱龛，内各雕一禅定坐佛，着通肩或双领下垂式袈裟。三是天宫伎乐与化生童子像。童子双手牵华绳，花带弧形交叉下垂；天宫伎乐面带微笑，手持毛员鼓、五弦、琴、铜钹、义觜笛、琵琶、齐鼓、腰鼓、筚篥、排箫、螺等乐器演奏。

Two thousand Buddhas, with 24 small arches, each of which sits on its shoulders or under its two fingers, with dildos on its shoulders. Three are plaque and chemist children. The child's hands are tied and the flowers are arcs cross over and down; the child's hand is smiled, hand-held drums, five strings, gins, bronzes, flute flute, gins, drums, rim drums, drums, gins, gins, platinums.

name_zh: 南壁东端第 4 层第 2 排圆拱龛
description_zh: 设计新颖的坐佛圆拱龛。龛柱雕为细高的束莲形，上端置束帛柱头。龛上隅呈翩飞之态的供养天均穿菩萨装。龛下二供养比丘与方足座的叠加，构成佛座与供养像的巧妙结合，当为云冈雕刻艺术的新设计。方足座两侧各一力士托举皿板，承托龛柱与上面的胁侍菩萨立像，既有佛教意义，又具装饰效果。
name_en: Eastern South Wall, 4th Floor, 2nd Platoon Arch
description_en: Designing a new Buddha's Arc. The pillars are sculpted with thin and tall bellows, with top-end beams on their heads. The skyscrapers, in the form of flimsy support, are dressed in talismans. The two below provide for the folding of the dunes with the square foot, and form a fine combination of the Buddhas and the engraved images, as a new design for the engraving of the engraved clouds. Each side of the squares is equipped with a plate to carry on board, which is a statue of the saly with which the pillars are held, both Buddhist and decorative.

description_zh: 位于第11窟窟门东侧，高约2.7米，宽约2米。可辨识千佛壁下层开凿一圆拱龛，上方另有一交脚菩萨、二胁侍菩萨造像。

name_zh: 第11-9窟主尊坐佛头部

There are dances, looking back, different gestures, and a strong sense of movement. In particular, it is creative to carve a lot of flowers at the bottom of the left.

description_zh: 男性供养人行列，人物面前有短栅榜题。群像头戴小冠，着交领宽袖大袍，双手合掌致礼。衣纹雕刻简单，袍摆后飘，好似列队行走的瞬间。
name_en: 11-16 Substrate Substrate Substrate Substrate Substrate Substrate
description_en: Men are the breadwinners, and the characters have a short-lined list. The crowd wears a small crown, hands in hand with a broad-sleeved robe, and gives gifts. The carvings are simple, and the robes float behind them, as if they were walking in a queue.

name_zh: 第11-16窟窟顶
description_zh: 窟顶平綦雕为九格，三角垂饰环饰四壁。井心中央为二龙，四角格内各雕一团莲，另四格各雕飞天。整体效果动静相宜、协调统一，是晚期洞窟中雕饰华丽的平綦之一。

name_zh: 前室西壁
description_zh: 壁面分上下四层龛像。第1层雕刻风化，现为后世涂抹之泥面。第2层置圆拱龛和宝盖龛，系“降服迦叶”故事。第3层为三间式屋形龛，由二方柱间隔，明间雕一交脚佛，两胁侍菩萨分立，两梢间各雕一倚坐佛。龛内佛像上侧雕飞天、华绳，屋脊雕三角纹与金翅鸟，屋檐下雕斗拱与人字叉手。龛外两侧各雕一胁侍菩萨。第4层北侧雕“阿输迦施土因缘”故事，南侧雕一坐佛，两侧各一梵志。佛像周侧雕飞天、供养天等形象。

The second layer consists of an arch and a treasure cap, which is the story of the "Down Gaea." The third floor is a three-storey house, with two pillars separated from each other, with two Buddhas separated from each other, and two Buddhas placed on each side. The upper side of the statue is carved with skylines, ridges and golden birds, and under the roofs with a sculptor and a man's fork. On the other side, one carves the story of the "Atschatts" on the north side, one Buddha on the south side, and one Vatican on each side.

name_zh: 前室西壁第3层龛主尊右胁侍菩萨
description_zh: 人物具头光，长眉、细眼、直鼻、小嘴，表面有涂白（清代）。戴项圈，臂腕戴钏镯，斜披络腋，下着长裙，帔帛绕臂飞扬。二像雕刻细腻，造像比例适中。左侧菩萨头戴三圆宝冠，正面莲盘上方饰仰月。菩萨面似满月、神情温雅。左手提净瓶垂膝，右手持物于胸前。右侧菩萨头戴三圆宝冠，正中圆莲吐穗，冠箍在侧面打结。左手提净瓶，右手持物于胸。

It wears a collar, a bracelet on its wrists, a tilted arm, a long skirt, and a large arm on its backs. The two statues are engraved, and the image is proportional. The left-hand bead wears three crowns of gold on its head, and the upper part of the plate looks like a full moon, and it looks gentle. The left hand holds its knees and the right hand holds on its chest. The right hand has three crowns on its head, and the right-hand bellows on its right side, and the middle-hand is sprawling and the crown closes on its side. The left hand holds a bottle and the right hand holds the chest.

One hand caress the chest, one hand caress the chest, and the other the chest lifts the chest, in the form of a "D" step towards the Buddha, standing above the table of the Lotus, in the form of natural harmony, and in an elegant gesture.

description_zh: 佛着半袒右肩式袈裟，跏趺坐于莲台之上，通身背光，可见光云。左下角雕魔子劝谏及魔众手执兵器向佛进攻的场面，右下角雕三魔女化为老妪的情节。这是表现“降魔成道”的佛经故事。故事图选取了降魔过程中的几个重要情节，集中表现在佛龛的两侧。

The lower left sculptor persuades the devils to attack the Buddha with his weapons, and the lower right sculpts the third woman to become an old woman. This is the story of the Buddha, which shows the "mortization into a way." The story draws several important elements of the depravity process, concentrated on both sides of the Buddha.

description_zh: 圆拱龛内雕坐佛，龛基铭石两侧雕供养人行列。龛像呈云冈晚期风格。南侧枝叶繁茂大树冠下，一比丘禅坐于方座上，僧囊悬挂于一旁的枝头，壁面略高于坐佛龛。由此说明壁面曾经打破关系：坐佛龛开凿于禅僧之后，可能是将大树主干甚至主干下另一禅僧剔除后雕凿的作品。

The 3rd floor Buddhist story is unknown.

name_zh: 第 12-1 窟题记残刻
description_zh: 窟门双塔共用一须弥座，基座正中残留方形题铭，可辨为：“玄事凝寂■/现其深口■/以显■■■/必内■■■/造像■■■/■元■■■”。两侧各雕5身供养人像，外侧雕返顾狮形。一般认为，此题记年代约在北魏景明年间。

Each of them provides for the human image and the outside one returns to the sphinx. It is generally believed that the writing is about the year of North Wei Xingming.

The left hand is broken, and the right hand is put up with a fearless mark, sitting on the table of the Lotus, and the coats are hanging and the tattoos are flowing. On the forehead, there is a circle of brows, connected with the thick eye, with the roots of the eyebrows, thick noses, thick lips, with beards on both sides connected with the horns, with screws and earrings. On the left hand is placed in front of the stomach, with the right hand holding the chest and the palms out. On the right side, the hair combing on the night fork, the eyebrows, long-eyes, long ears, and round heads. On the side of the skirt, the outside cross, the lower half of the body, the left fork, and the right hand placing of the chest.

name_zh: 中心塔柱东面下层内龛外左下侧护法夜叉
description_zh: 中心塔柱东面下层内龛外两下侧护法夜叉左侧夜叉头梳双层卷发，上层外卷、下层内卷。额头中有圆形凸起，浓眉相连，眉毛根根竖立，凸眼大鼻、双唇厚实，络腮胡须两层与鬓角相连、呈螺形，耳饰环。左手置于腹前，右手握物胸前、掌心向外。
name_en: Bottom east of the central tower. Lower left fork.
description_en: On the lower east side of the central pillar, the guard on the left side of the night fork combs the double curly hair, the upper fork, the upper fork, the lower fork. On the forehead, there is a circle of browsed, a thick forebrow connected, a deep forebrow, a deep forebrow, a thick forebrow, a thick forebrow, a thick forebrow, two forebrows connected to the horn, a screwdling, a earring ring. Left hand in front of the stomach, right hand holding the chest, palm out.

name_zh: 中心塔柱西面上层主尊左胁侍菩萨头部
description_zh: 左右两侧的胁侍菩萨立于九层塔柱内侧，高约2.2米，其中左胁侍菩萨背靠塔柱、面向北，头戴山形宝冠，面相丰圆、细眉长眼、嘴角上收，饰桃形头光。人物耳戴饰、颈饰圈，上身着十字帔帛，帔角外翻，下身着长裙，裙带腰间结带下垂，裙腰外翻，双手合掌于右侧胸前，立于圆形莲台之上。
name_en: The top of the central tower pillar is the head of the Buddha's Lord Left.
description_en: On the left and left sides, the bellows stand on the inner side of the nine-storey towers, about 2.2 metres high, with the left bass on the back of the towers, facing north, wearing a mountain crown, with large faces, long eyebrows, horns, peach-shaped heads. A man wears an ear and neck ring, has a cross on his upper neck, flips out, has a long skirt, has a strap between his skirts, flips out of his skirts, his hands on the right side of his chest, and stands above a circle of lotuses.

name_zh: 东壁北侧第3层龛左梵志
description_zh: 这是一组救火梵志的外道形象。他们头束高髻，大眼，眼窝及脸颊深陷，眉端卷曲，蓄须，颈部肌肉呈条束状。人物均袒上身，瘦骨嶙峋，斜披巾帛，下穿裙，赤足。他们或背瓶罐、或抱水罐赶来救火。其中一蓄山羊胡须的梵志，右手持钵倾水救援，看似杯水车薪，体现的却是他对佛陀的态度。
name_en: 3rd floor on the north side of the east wall.
description_en: This is an external image of a fire-fighting van. Their heads are high, their eyes are big, their eyes and cheeks are deep, their eyebrows are curled, their beards are held, their neck muscles are strewn. The characters are full of heights, thin bones, their shawl, their skirts, their bare feet. They come to save the fire, either with a bottle or a water can. One of them is a goat's moustache, with his right hand pouring water, and it looks like a water truck wage, reflecting his attitude towards Buddha.

name_zh: 东壁北侧第3层龛左梵志

name_zh: 后室北壁上层龛主尊交脚菩萨
description_zh: 此交脚菩萨像，高约4.8米，头戴三面冠，两侧宝缯飞扬，脸部圆润，臂、腕戴钏、镯，胸佩璎珞与龙形饰。左手握法衣抚膝，右手上举胸前为施无畏印。肩绕帔帛，下身着羊肠大裙，脚踏小型圆形莲台。腹部与腿部曾经后世包泥绘彩，左腿部分泥皮剥落处可见北魏原雕衣纹及色彩。
name_en: In the back room, above the north wall, the Lord has the Buddha's hand.
description_en: It's a pamphlet, about 4.8 metres high, wearing a three-faced crown on both sides, a round face, an arm, a wrist, a bracelet, a chest, and a dragon. The left hand caressed his knees, and the right hand was put on his chest with a fearless mark. The shoulder was covered with a lamb intestinal skirt, and he stepped on a small circle of lice. There was a mud on the stomach and leg. Part of the left leg of the mud was taken off to see the coats and colours of the North Weijun.

description_zh: 后室北壁上层龛内东西侧思惟菩萨两菩萨均头戴三面冠，正面圆盘上方饰仰月。辫发披肩，饰耳珰，肩绕帔帛。菩萨面含微笑，以手支颐呈思考状。
name_en: In the back room, inside the upper north wall, the east and the west side are thinking of the Buddha.
description_en: On the top of the northern wall of the back room, the eastern and eastern sides of the Buddha's temples are only three-faced crowns on their heads, with the moon on their front discs. They have hairs and ears and their shoulders around them. They have a smile on their faces, and their hands are reflective.

name_zh: 后室西壁南侧第2层龛梵志
description_zh: 后室西壁南侧第2层龛两侧梵志众梵志动作各异，有的正双手捧瓶运水，有的双手执瓶倾倒，有的一手托瓶、一手高举倒水。虽然是灭火救人的紧急关头，但每个人的脸上看不到一丝紧张慌乱的神色，甚至还流露出微笑，仿佛他们已经预知法力无边的佛陀在火中会安然无恙。
name_en: In the back room, on the south side of the west wall, the 2nd floor of Vance.
description_en: In the back room, on the second floor, on the south side of the western wall, the Vaticans were different in their movements, with their right hands carrying bottles of water, their hands throwing bottles, and their hands lifting up and pouring water. Although it was an emergency time to put an end to the fire, everyone’s face did not see a state of tension or even a smile, as if they had predicted that the mighty Buddha would be safe in the fire.

name_zh: 后室西壁北侧第5层圆拱龛主尊坐佛
description_zh: 握法衣，右手上举为施无畏印。两侧各有三排供养天像，双手合十礼敬。龛楣正中以一坐佛为中心，两侧各雕8身供养天，现存11身。龛外的右上隅雕二供养比丘像，具圆形头光，左上隅雕像风化漫漶，应为对称布局。
name_en: In the back room, on the north side of the west wall, the fifth circle of arches sits in the Buddha.
description_en: He held the coat and held the right hand as a fearless mark. There were three rows on each side to feed the statues, and his hands to the tenth. He was centred on the Buddha, and the eight bodies on each side to feed the day, and there were 11 bodies. The top right sculpt, on the other side, was symmetrical.

name_zh: 后室南壁窟门东西侧塔形柱
description_zh: 后室南壁窟门东西侧塔形柱方塔各层均塑造了童子形象的双夜叉，姿态多样、活泼生趣。这种早在犍陀罗艺术时代就被安排在门口或窗口的护法形象，在云冈亦出现在相同的位置。塔顶山花蕉叶亦是来自科林斯式柱头的变化形式。
name_en: An east-west tower at the south wall door in the back room.
description_en: In the back room, the east and east side towers of the south wall door all the floors of the pylons have shaped the image of the child, with a variety of gestures and liveliness. This image, which has been set up as a guardian at the door or window since the time of the art of Xindra, is in the same place as in the Yunoka. The tiles of the towers are also a form of change from the Corinth-style poles.

name_zh: 后室门窗间方形龛两侧龛柱
description_zh: 方形龛两侧各立一龛柱，柱体修长、端丽，柱头上装饰一对向下的涡卷纹，类似印度元宝式柱头。
name_en: In the back room, between the windows and the squares, on both sides.
description_en: The squares form one pillar on each side, and the pillars are long and beautiful, and the columns are decorated with a pair of vortex stripes down, similar to the Indian Won Treasures.

name_zh: 后室北壁上层龛主佛左手及腿部衣纹
description_zh: 佛像左手保存完好，手指纤细，屈中指与无名指，手背圆润厚实。佛像腿部衣褶线条清晰，衣褶为隆起的平行线条，自然弯曲的褶带纹样具有云冈早期服饰雕刻的特点。
name_en: On the top of the north wall of the back room, the Buddha's left hand and legs were tattooed.
description_en: The Buddha's left hand is well preserved, its fingers are thin, its fingers are thin and its hands are thick and thick. The Buddha's legs are clear in their garments, they are lined in parallel, and the naturally bending ribbons are characterized by early engraved carvings of the clouds.

name_en: 2nd floor east of the North Wall, 1st Platoon, 1st Platoon Head
description_en: The brother is as if his head were stretched out of the cave, and the body below his neck is hidden in the wall. The man has a sharp nose, almond core, eyebrow rises, eyebrow bends on his eyebrow, ears and cheekbones, causing the upper lip to be dazzled. name_zh: 主佛头部
description_zh: 主佛多角度的面部，呈现不同的艺术效果。正面看，额头宽广饱满，嘴角刻画鲜明，显得果决坚毅，丰面圆颐、大耳长郭，流露着和蔼、威严的神情。侧面看，主佛头部从壁面几欲脱出，近乎圆雕。额头与鼻梁呈一条线，直达鼻尖。匠师运刀如笔，娴熟地运用匀细流畅的线条，生动地表现出佛像的质感、量感及衣饰的韵律感。
name_en: Lord Buddha's head.
description_en: On the front, the head of the Buddha has different artistic effects. On the front, the forehead is wide and full, the mouth is sharp, and it appears to be determined, strong, round, big-eared, and has a nice, powerful look. On the side, the head of the Buddha is a little bit off the wall, close to a round. The head is lined with the nose, straight up to the nose. The craftsmen carry knives like pens, use smooth lines, and display vividly the tone of the quality, measure and clothing of the Buddha.

description_zh: 主尊与东西立佛间凹进北壁壁面的空间，各雕刻一立姿菩萨，现均仅残存菩萨的上半身、双腿轮廓及腿间下垂的裙角。因后世开隧道，造像腹部被凿成大方孔。菩萨头部缺失，但可辨其颈佩项圈、饰联珠纹。人物斜披络腋，臂佩联珠纹钏，上置圆形饰。双足呈八字形踏于方台之上。
name_en: The Lord's Two-Save Buddha.
description_en: The Lord and the East and the West gnawed into the space of the northern wall, each carved a pulp and left only the upper part of the pagoda, the contour of the legs and the skirt of the lower leg. As a result of the opening of the tunnels of the future, the abdominal parts were carved into large holes. The Buddha's head was missing, but he could see his neck and collars and beads. The characters slanted their necks, their arms and beads, and placed round beads on them. The two feet were eight twigs above the square.
